authority: navigation and presentation analysis only; no Identity, recognition, readiness, rank, authority, governance, Treasury, entitlement, or capability effect
purpose: Test whether the exact 5+10+5 face decomposition of the Vitae icosahedron can host two meaningful five-specialization navigation families without inventing hierarchy, exclusivity, mastery tracks, grade correspondences, or unsupported doctrine.

geometric_fact.fivefold_orientation: A regular icosahedron decomposes into one five-face cap, one ten-face equatorial belt, and one five-face cap.

original_partition_under_test.reason: The labels overstate a spirit/matter-style polarity not present in the specialization canon. Hierophant is primarily threshold/rite/pacing/process stewardship, while Enchanter is primarily meaning/resonance/atmosphere/symbol stewardship.

specialization_domain_evidence.primary_domain: thresholds, rites, pacing, liminal transition safety

relationship_graph_test.source: Cross-Specialization Constraints sections in the ten specialization responsibility/invariant canons.
relationship_graph_test.method: Each declared defer/coordinate/collaborate target is counted as one directed relationship for structural corroboration only. Relationship types are intentionally not weighted. Complement-equivalent 5+5 partitions are counted once by fixing Arcanist in family A.
relationship_graph_test.boundary: This graph is evidence of current declared coordination structure, not proof of ontology. A family must still pass semantic and governance tests.

family_A.shared_function: Steward how experience is known, interpreted, perceived, contextualized, and resonantly framed without authority.

family_B.shared_function: Steward thresholds, living systems, endings, transformation, and constructed form without coercion or hierarchy.

recommended_navigation_partition.critical_boundary: These are navigation families, not schools, identities, prerequisites, ranks, exclusive tracks, personality types, or mastery paths.
recommended_navigation_partition.orientation_neutrality: Either family may occupy either geometric cap. North/south, top/bottom, light/dark, heaven/earth, masculine/feminine, spirit/matter, subtle/dense, superior/inferior, or advanced/basic meanings are prohibited unless separately and legitimately sourced; none are granted here.

cross_specialization_mastery_paths_docum.finding: No balanced 5+5 partition can preserve all three triplets as complete cap families because the two non-Wizard triplets alone contain six distinct specializations. Therefore cap families cannot be defined as mastery-path families.

governance_conflict.mastery_path_governance_canon: States that cross-specialization combinations are situational/practitioner-specific and must not be enumerated or formalized, and separately rejects formal Wizard/Magus-style master titles.
governance_conflict.cross_specialization_mastery_paths_canon: Enumerates Wizard, Magus, and Architect archetypes with minimum specialization triplets.
governance_conflict.effect_on_this_audit: Neither document may be silently used to turn the two caps into mastery tracks. The cap model remains navigation-only.

family_boundary_tests.cross_family_practice: PASS — canonical non-exclusivity requires cross-cap practice to remain ordinary and unrestricted.
family_boundary_tests.cap_cycle_semantics: FAIL if C5 edges are interpreted as privileged specialization pairings; PASS if edges are presentation-only.
family_boundary_tests.cap_to_grade_spokes: FAIL — the five geometric cap-to-belt edges may not become specialization↔Grade dependencies or correspondences.
family_boundary_tests.top_bottom_hierarchy: FAIL if vertical orientation creates prestige or spiritual/material rank; PASS only with swappable/equivalent caps.
family_boundary_tests.completion: FAIL if filling a cap means specialization mastery; specializations remain infinite in depth and non-terminal.
family_boundary_tests.identity: FAIL if family membership becomes a user type or identity label; roles are inhabited, not identities.

renderer_requirements: Both caps must have identical geometry, interaction affordance, brightness range, and information density.
Cap placement must be swappable without changing meaning.
Do not draw specialization↔Grade spokes as semantic links unless a separately sourced relationship exists.
Do not treat the five cap-cycle edges as prerequisites, preferred combinations, or incompatibilities.
Cross-cap navigation must be as easy as within-cap navigation.
Provide equivalent card/list navigation independent of 3D geometry.
Family labels must remain descriptive and revisable; specialization names and mandates remain primary.
candidate_laws: Family Membership Is Navigation Metadata, Not Identity.
A Cap Is Not a Rank.
A Five-Face Cycle Does Not Create Five Required Pairings.
Family Labels Describe Functions; They Do Not Divide Spirit From Matter.
Mastery Overlay Is Not Family Taxonomy.
Relationship Graph May Corroborate a Cluster; It May Not Author Doctrine.
Geometry May Cluster Domains; It May Not Close Practice.

final_disposition.next_gate: Prototype the revised 5+10+5 Vitae view with the ten Grade belt, the two swappable specialization caps, no semantic spokes, and equal card/list navigation; separately reconcile the mastery-path governance contradiction before any canonical family language is considered.
